answer_text:
Let

\[
F(x)=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\binom{2n}{n}x^n.
\]

A standard generating function for the central binomial coefficients is

\[
F(x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-4x}}, \qquad |x|<\frac14.
\]

We need

\[
S=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac{2n}{8^n}\binom{2n}{n}
=2\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} n\binom{2n}{n}\left(\frac18\right)^n.
\]

For a power series,

\[
\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} n a_n x^n = xF'(x),
\]

so

\[
\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} n\binom{2n}{n}x^n
=xF'(x).
\]

Now compute

\[
F(x)=(1-4x)^{-1/2},
\]

so

\[
F'(x)=2(1-4x)^{-3/2}.
\]

Therefore,

\[
\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} n\binom{2n}{n}x^n
=2x(1-4x)^{-3/2}.
\]

Evaluate at \(x=\frac18\):

\[
\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} n\binom{2n}{n}\left(\frac18\right)^n
=
2\cdot \frac18 \left(1-\frac12\right)^{-3/2}
=
\frac14\left(\frac12\right)^{-3/2}.
\]

Thus

\[
S
=
2\cdot \frac14\left(\frac12\right)^{-3/2}
=
\frac12\left(\frac12\right)^{-3/2}.
\]

Since

\[
\left(\frac12\right)^{-3/2}=2^{3/2}=2\sqrt2,
\]

we get

\[
S=\frac12\cdot 2\sqrt2=\sqrt2.
\]

\[
\boxed{\sqrt2}
\]
